---
title: "Background"
author: "Emma Caetano"
---

College softball is a fast-paced, highly competitive sport played at the NCAA level, where teams rely on pitching, defense, and timely hitting to win. Players often build their skills through travel ball, training, and recruiting, and every game can turn on small details like pitch selection, contact quality, and fielding execution. The sport blends athleticism with strategy, making it a strong topic for analyzing player performance and team success.
